services.desc: Relax on a day full of luxury aboard an exclusive sailing catamaran, explore the beautiful north coast of the island and snorkel in crystal clear waters. Get ready to enjoy the imposing mountains that dominate the horizon and keep your eyes wide open, you may be lucky enough to see flying fish and dolphins swimming in the warm waters. services.name: Scuba Diving
services.desc: If you are looking for more personalized dive experience, we can organize a private dive in Punta Cana - in Bavaro or Playa Blanca. The private dive is perfect if you would prefer to dive alone with a divemaster and family member, you’ll have a dive profesional assigned to your family along with boat and captain. If you are interested in receiving more information, please fill out the contact form below and let us know what type of private dive charter you would prefer. services.name: Parasailing Punta Cana
services.desc: Parasailing is an incredible adventure and one of the top things to do in Punta Cana! The coastline from 200 feet up in the air as you set sail is absolutely breathtaking and a fun experience for all the family. There are certain weight restrictions for parasailing individually. The minimum weight for parasailing is 110 lb/50 kg and maximum weight of 400 lb/181kg. Guests weighing under 110 lb/50 kg will have to fly with another guest. services.name: Electric Surf
services.desc: Get ready to experience a thrilling ride that redefines water sports. With no need for wind or waves, this high-powered electric surfboard lets you carve through the water and explore untouched coastal views with total freedom. After a safety briefing and quick intro lesson, you’ll gear up and start gliding through the waves on your electric board. No waiting for surf conditions-just pure adrenaline and panoramic coastal beauty. A support boat stays nearby the entire time to ensure your safety and offer guidance. blurb: SeaPro Divers offers scuba diving experiences and private charter excursions in Punta Cana and Puerto Plata. They provide PADI certification courses from Open Water Diver to Divemaster level, mostly lasting 3 days. Excursions include diving, snorkeling, fishing, and catamaran rides along the coast.
